title: PolyComp: A Polycube-based Benchmark for Compositional 3D Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.14741v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce PolyComp, a procedurally generated and verified benchmark that stresses visual recognition and compositional spatial reasoning. In each problem, a model must identify which of four options shows a pair of polycube components that can be combined to form a target solid. The benchmark contains 120 problems across four geometry families, and each problem has three different presentation formats using either a single image or multiple images. The random guessing baseline is 25%. Across the three presentations (360 presented problems per model), GPT-5.6 Sol with max effort attains 50.0% accuracy (95% problem-cluster CI 43.3-56.7%) at a mean cost of \$0.951 per presented problem, Claude Fable 5 with max effort attains 39.4% (33.1-46.1%) at \$0.701, and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview with thinking level high attains 27.5% (22.8-32.5%), near the 25% random guessing baseline, at \$0.350. translated_title: PolyComp：基于多立方体的多模态模型组合三维空间推理基准
translated_abstract: 我们引入了PolyComp，这是一个程序化生成并验证的基准，旨在测试视觉识别和组合空间推理能力。在每道题目中，模型必须识别四个选项中哪一个展示了两个多立方体组件，这些组件可以组合成一个目标实体。该基准包含四个几何族中的120个问题，每个问题有三种不同的呈现格式，使用单张或多张图像。随机猜测的基线准确率为25%。在三种呈现方式下（每个模型共360个呈现问题），GPT-5.6 Sol在最大努力下达到50.0%的准确率（95%问题簇置信区间43.3-56.7%），平均每个呈现问题成本为0.951美元；Claude Fable 5在最大努力下达到39.4%（33.1-46.1%），成本为0.701美元；Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview在高度思考级别下达到27.5%（22.8-32.5%），接近25%的随机猜测基线，成本为0.350美元。观察到的准确率在几何族之间存在差异。
tldr: 该论文提出了PolyComp基准，通过120个程序化生成的问题测试多模态模型的组合三维空间推理能力，结果显示GPT-5.6 Sol达到50%准确率，显著优于其他模型，但仍远未达到完美。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PolyComp, a benchmark with 120 procedurally generated problems for compositional 3D spatial reasoning, showing GPT-5.6 Sol achieves 50% accuracy, outperforming other models but still far from perfect.
